title: AIXBT crypto agent sends 55 ETH to an attacker after its dashboard is breached
summary: AIXBT, an AI agent built on Virtuals Protocol that posts crypto market commentary, sent about 55 ETH (roughly $100,000) from its simulation wallet to an attacker after two malicious replies, following what its maintainer 0rxbt called a dashboard access hack that did not reach core systems. The team paused the dashboard, swapped servers and migrated keys; the maintainer said the loss was not a result of agent manipulation, and no detailed technical breakdown had been published.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17; headline, publication date 2025-03-18 (The Block, Daniel Kuhn), the 55 ETH / $100,000 figures, the two malicious replies, and the dashboard pause, server swap and key migration are confirmed from the article body. The article is internally inconsistent on cause: the maintainer says the loss was not agent manipulation (a dashboard access hack), while the article's Quick Take describes malicious prompting reaching the simulation wallet; no technical postmortem existed at publication.
